'''Dispersal Adjustors''' were components used in [[Stokhli/Legends|Stokhli]] [[Spray stick/Legends|spray sticks]]. The adjustors were positioned at the end of the weapon, behind the nozzle that fired the [[spraymist]].<ref name="EGWT" />
